run_f_gold: run f_gold to construct the minimum number from an ID sequence pattern
test_f_gold: test f_gold against sample ID sequences to verify correct minimum number generation
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that builds minimum number from increase decrease sequence
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to return a string instead of a list of digit integers
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which generates minimum number digits from an ID pattern string
